card.name: The plus-minus sign in tolerances
card.fires_on: The plus-minus sign (±) right after words like mean, within, accurate to or days, where a tolerance or spread follows. Seen in drug label text.

modes.label: Tolerance range
modes.description: The ± sign gives an allowed margin on a timing, accuracy or dose window.

modes.label: Mean ± SD
modes.description: The ± sign follows the word mean and comes before SD in pharmacokinetic results.
modes.example: There was a mean<< ±>> SD increase in tolbutamide AUC
